dataset.name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection
dataset.source: Asia Pacific Tele-Ophthalmology Society · Aravind Eye Hospital (India)

steps.title: Load & orient
steps.detail: Decode image, apply EXIF transpose, convert to RGB.

steps.title: CLAHE
steps.detail: Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalisation on the L channel of LAB (clip 2.0, 8×8 tiles) — enhances vessels, microaneurysms and exudates without shifting colour.

steps.title: Pad to square
steps.detail: Preserve aspect ratio; Lanczos resize to fit 512×512 with centred black padding (no cropping).

steps.title: Model resize
steps.detail: 512×512 for the custom CNN; Lanczos-3 resize to 224×224 for EfficientNetB0 / ResNet50.

alternatives_tested.name: Ben Graham enhancement
alternatives_tested.detail: 4·(img − GaussianBlur(img, σ=10)) + 128 — strong local-contrast filter; kept as an experiment.

alternatives_tested.name: Conservative cropping
alternatives_tested.detail: Crop black borders before padding — skipped for most images to avoid cutting the retina.

alternatives_tested.name: Resize strategy
alternatives_tested.detail: Stretch vs aspect-preserving pad — padding chosen to keep lesion geometry.

augmentation.policy: Only minority grades (1–4) of the training split are augmented until each matches grade 0 (1,263). Validation and test stay untouched.
augmentation.leakage_check: Passed — original train / validation / test IDs are disjoint and every raw ID appears exactly once.

insights.title: Severe class imbalance
insights.detail: Half of the images are 'No DR' while 'Severe' is only 5.3% — a 9.4 : 1 ratio. Accuracy alone is misleading; we report macro-F1 and QWK.

insights.title: Resolution differs by grade
insights.detail: Grade 0 images are mostly 1050×1050 (aspect 1.17) while diseased grades are ~2500×1800 (aspect ≈ 1.40). After square padding the black-border pattern differs by class — a potential shortcut models could exploit. Grad-CAM in the Diagnose page helps check this.

insights.title: CLAHE triples visible detail
insights.detail: On 400 paired images edge density rose from 0.016 to 0.052 (×3.2) and contrast (brightness std) nearly doubled, while mean brightness stayed the same.

insights.title: Clean dataset
insights.detail: No missing labels, duplicates, unreadable or orphan files; all 3,662 images are RGB.

insights.title: Augmentation is heavy for rare grades
insights.detail: Severe has 135 originals expanded to 1,263 (~8×). Rotations/flips create variety but cannot add new pathology — minority-grade recall remains the main weakness.

insights.title: 17 different cameras / resolutions
insights.detail: Images range from 474×358 to 4288×2848, so every image is standardised to 512×512 before training.
